brief.headline: Carlyle to acquire $7.7bn consumer loan portfolio from Truist
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Carlyle has agreed to acquire a $7.7bn (£5.8bn) portfolio of unsecured personal loans from US bank Truist as it expands its asset-backed finance (ABF) business.

Fundraising: Aldaron, a newly established private equity firm founded by former executives from Palantir and Carlyle, has closed its debut fund with approximately $885m in commitments, according to a report by The Wall Street Journal.

Family Offices & Wealth: Regal Partners portfolio manager Henry Hill is bidding farewell to the country 's best-known hedge fund to join Perpetual, which has Swedish buyout EQT Partners on its tail....

M&A & Buyouts: Bankers and advisers involved in Apollo Global Management's £5.7bn acquisition of easyJet are expected to receive approximately £334m in fees, making the transaction one of the UK's most lucrative takeovers for dealmakers this year, according to a report by the Financial Times.

Infrastructure & Energy: Blackstone has built a data centre portfolio valued at $200bn, including debt and projects under construction, as the alternative asset manager expands its investments across artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to a report by Bloomberg.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.19% (down 2 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.33 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.23%, near long-run norms (down 2 bps on the prior reading).
